This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This is the standard expression for setting a story in an ancient time period; the original phrase is not used naturally here.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，When the verb means “to see/noticesomething,” use “看到”; “看” means “to look at.”
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 。一些人一吃植物就生病了：，就发现一些人一吃植物就生病了，The pattern “一……就……” needs “就” to introduce the result that follows the event of seeing.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions, while “在古代” is correct.
“看到” is needed, but “一看到” still requires a following “就……” result clause.
The preceding “一看到……” needs a “就……” clause, but the displayed correction is only a cut-off continuation.
